_note: Tier 0 fixture — Divorce, WHITESPACE variant (c) — as Marriage's, over Divorce's six mirrored keys. The husband's dob / nationality / address.villageId carry surrounding whitespace (the mirror trims, `husband.*` does not), nationality is whitespace-only so its mirror collapses to "", and name / id_number / marriage_certificate_ref are the both-sides-trimmed controls. Synthetic throughout: no real citizen data, no real UIN, no token (F0-AC-70 item 2). Values are DISTINCT wherever the source permits distinctness (§ 6.5.3 item 3), so a transposition of two keys is caught by value as well as by the ordered paths[] list. Locale seed: lo. The `lo` file is IDENTICAL to its `en` sibling in every INPUT — the locale is a SEED, not an input. Any difference in the derived oracle therefore comes from the source resolving a value under that locale, which is exactly what F0-AC-35's Guard A and F0-AC-36's complement guard partition.
